item.title: Version 1.7.1
item.description:
• Sync diagnostics: a small log (Diagnostics/sync.log next to the database) of iCloud notification registration, notifications received, sync events and app activation, to find out why changes from another Mac arrive only when the app is brought to the front.
  • The first version installed with Check for Updates….

item.title: Version 1.7
item.description:
• Check for Updates… in the Car Projects Manager menu, and an automatic check once a day. Updates download and install from inside the app (no more "downloaded from the Internet" question), and are only accepted when signed with the app's update key, Developer ID signed and notarized.
  • Includes 1.6.2: iCloud changes from your other Mac arrive in the background.
